Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing street, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: center; parking: lot
- commercial building at center, 1 story, brick, glass, pitched roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: grass strip, hedge
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait image — one single frame. Expand the SAME
scene naturally above (sky) and below (street/pavement) — this is canvas
extension of one photograph, not additional panels. Do not stretch or distort
the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1995
Clinton era prosperity. A 1995 self-serve station — wide canopy over multiple islands, attached convenience store, the first pay-at-pump card readers.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- attached convenience store with lottery and cigarette ads in the glass
- no full service attendants
- price sign showing gas around $1.15
- main sign: "Casey's" branded gas station — Casey's pole sign with price display and Casey's colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: '32oz FOUNTAIN DRINK 89¢', 'CAR WASH $4 WITH FILL-UP'
- a wire rack of free auto-trader papers by the door
- a bench with a local realtor ad by the ice machine
Typography: clean geometric sans-serif, early digital influence.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 5 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles; sidewalks busy, driving lanes clear.
- a clerk restocking the ice merchandiser
- a parent and kid walking into the store
- an office worker with a pager on his belt
Clothing: men in baggy jeans, grunge style; women in chokers, high-waisted mom jeans. Fashion palette: forest green, maroon, mustard yellow. No posing or eye contact. All people on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — the driving lanes stay empty of pedestrians. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 1992-1995 Honda Civic — small rounded coupe and sedan — navy blue
- 1994-1998 Ford Mustang — rounded SN95 pony car — burgundy
- 1992-1996 Toyota Camry — rounded, understated — teal
- 1995-2004 Toyota Tacoma — compact, rounded — hunter green
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1995.
All vehicles obey normal US right-hand traffic flow — parked parallel to the curb, each facing the same direction as its adjacent lane. Nothing sideways, diagonal, or against traffic.
At least one full driving lane in each direction stays clear of parked vehicles, meters, and curb infrastructure — through traffic is never blocked.
One of these vehicles is parked at the pump island with its driver standing beside it refueling.
PLACEMENT: the first two parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn lane arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable TV and early phone data lines on poles

TREES
- deciduous tree at right: established tree, modest canopy
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodak Gold 200 or Fujifilm Superia 200 look.
Color: neutral to slightly warm tones. Grain: fine grain, cleaner than 1985.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1992-1995 Honda Civic — small rounded coupe and sedan
1994-1998 Ford Mustang — rounded SN95 pony car
